name: Spicy Tofu & Pepper Stir-Fry with Cilantro Rice

instructions.primary_message: Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the tofu in half horizontally to form two thin planks. Place the tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place a baking sheet with something heavy (like a skillet) on top to press out excess water. Set aside.

Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Season the rice with salt and add water; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cups basmati rice
1 ½ tsp salt
6 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
3 yellow bell peppers
1 ½ small bunches cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Remove the seeds and membrane from the peppers and cut into strips; place them in a large bowl.
Once the water for the rice is boiling, reduce the heat to low, stir, and cover. Cook until the liquid is absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Remove from the heat and let the rice stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Peel and slice the onion into thin half moons; add to the bowl with the peppers.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, large dice the tofu (cut into ¾-inch cubes).
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the tofu, and cook, stirring occasionally, until it starts to brown, about 5 minutes.
Combine soy sauce, water, maple syrup, and chili-garlic in a small bowl, whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup soy sauce
3 tbsp water
2 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: When tofu is brown, add the soy mixture to the skillet along with the pepper and onions. Stir occasionally, until the vegetables begin to brown, about 5 minutes. Cook in batches if necessary.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork; add cilantro to rice, reserving some for garnish.
Divide the rice between plates and top with the tofu and pepper mixture. Garnish with cilantro and cashews and enjoy!
